name: The physician worried over your complexion

props.ChoiceTitle: The physician worried over your complexion
props.ChoiceText: A physician looked too long at your pallor, pulse, and heaviness of spirit, and spoke of black bile as if naming an old tenant who had settled too deeply in the house.
props.ChoiceBio: Diagnosis gave your inward weather a body, which was both relief and fresh cause for dread.

1.TargetText: The physician who named your complexion still comes to mind whenever your thoughts darken.

0.Amount: You learned that sorrow of spirit can wear the face of a bodily imbalance and still feel no less personal.
